There's a huge problem in the game's text that can't be solved without a significant change to the technical writing of the source text. I believe it's a very reasonable change to ask for, considering its similarity in scope to the recent Fixed/Pure DMG change.

# This term `「打击」`/`"Strike"` is __far__ too ambiguous.
Too many problems arise from this single word being used for 3 very distinct, separate things. I urge you, we **__MUST__** properly delineate ALL instances of this term `「打击」`/`"Strike"` into the actual terms each instance refers to:

-  `基础「打击」`/`Basic "Strike"`
  - (the card literally named __"Strike"__, or Horla's "Snarl Psalm"), 
- `打击卡`/`Strike card`
  - (any __card__ that has the Strike designation), and
- `打击`/`Strikes`
  - (__any__ action with the Strike designation, e.g. Mouchette's Pursuit).

I have before successfully convinced the writing team to be more specific in defining the first item as such, and I believe it's necessary to continue this to its conclusion.

Some work I've submitted in the past naively substituted this term `「打击」` for `Strike Command` as I had been unaware of Mouchette's (and now Lotan: Cetarchon's) Strike Pursuit. The research I've done has also made me realize "Command" is too narrow here as well, because while currently there are no non-Command Strike cards, the underlying mechanics do allow for it.

My confusion here was not unique, as there is much uncertainty over what things that apply to `"Strike"` apply to Deadly Encounter or don't. We NEED to split this term `「打击」` so that players are able to more easily determine how all these effects actually work.

# Here are some examples:

- (Faded Legacy Relic) **Modern Axle**
> 每回合第一次打出指令卡后，将对应唤醒体的一张`基础「打击」`置入手中，赋予其<:warn:1408311425952387122>虚无和<:warn:1408311425952387122>消耗。
> 
> Once per turn, after a Command Card is played, create one of that Awakener's `Basic "Strike."` It has <:warn:1408311425952387122>__Fleeting__ and <:warn:1408311425952387122>__Exhaust__.

- (Wheel of Destiny) **Song of the Bound**
> 队伍唯一：探索开始时将一张「灵感」和装备者的`基础「打击」`加入牌库，装备者`打击`基础伤害提高 X%，打出后有 X% 概率抽 1 张牌。该效果每回合最多触发 1 次。若当前界域为「超维」并在超维回合中，`打击卡`将 1 张「灵感」置入手中，当回合最多触发 1 次。
> 
> At the start of investigation, add 1 "Insight" and 1 of the wielder's `Basic "Strike"` to the deck. The Base DMG of the wielder's `Strikes` +X%. When one of their `Strike cards` is played, there is a X% chance to draw a card, up to 1 time per turn. The first time one of their `Strike cards` is played during each Ultra Round, create 1 "Insight."

- (Helot Exalt) **Surviving Impasse**
> 【<:warn:1408311425952387122>吞噬>：抽 3 张`打击卡`，临时手牌上限 +2，使希洛的`打击`基础伤害在本场战斗中提高 X%。】驱散自身<:z_weakness:1446691118161854616>**虚弱**和非永久<:z_strdown:1446690980450275358>**力量**降低状态，在本回合中`打击`造成的伤害提高 X%，希洛造成的伤害提高 X%。
> 
> [<:warn:1408311425952387122>Devour: Draw 3 `Strike cards`; Hand Limit +2 this turn. The Base DMG of Helot's `Strikes` +X% in this battle.] Cleanse <:z_weakness:1446691118161854616>**Weakness** and Temp. <:z_strdown:1446690980450275358>**STR▼**. This turn, the Final DMG of all `Strikes` +X%, and Helot's DMG +X%.

- (Mouchette Command) **Mortal Blast**
> 视为`打击`。对全体敌方造成 X 点伤害 X 次，生成 1 张上一次打出的其他`打击卡`的临时复制并使其算力消耗 -1。
> 
> `Strike:` Deal X DMG to all enemies X times, then create 1 temporary copy of the last `Strike card` played (other than Mortal Blast), with -1 Arithmetica Cost.

I sincerely hope you seriously consider this proposal and recognize how important it is to make this change. Thank you.

content: Talent says Strike enjoys 50% tentacle damage, Strike has enjoy 100% tentacle damage by default so in combat it should be 150% total but it's still 100%
limited unwinds where?

A lot of characters have their "auto unlocked" talent effects on the base version of their skills, you'll find that basically everyone with a substat scaling talent etc has their substat scaling applied out of combat as well
Like these talents don't actually do anything in most cases in terms of eg adding a buff that increases tentacle damage by +50%, they seem to just exist to explain the baseline scaling/effects
So do I bug report SkeyDB instead for misleading me?
Theoretically, the talent links on the website are made manually in most cases, since again, the talents don't actually "do anything"

It kind of makes sense why it's done this way.. Since the talent is unlocked automatically and isn't content locked, it doesn't have to interact with the skills like a SF talent or an Enlighten does because its always active, but it is a little annoying for the website to deal with 😔
It could also be a bug, and the intended value is 150%, can't really answer that, but far as I know this seems to be standard practice for the "innate" talents.
So, what do we do with this post?
It's probably better that they clarify, if they can.
